activation: Only after all main practice arms terminate and only if the parent and first-fork diagnosis qualify. Run on the same frozen practice and host-held independent rosters for paired comparison; no selection results are read before these two arms finish.

alternate.preservation: Use the original C stratified anchors and inequality solver. Same targets, rank, and full generation gate.

conventional.policy: Project merged low-rank delta into the .33 floating-point ball after each optimizer step. The .35 realized stored-precision cap remains authoritative. Train on complete accepted target and preservation continuations, then measure the full practice endpoint if within the cap.
